scope: Research evidence only: nonzero MPEG Surround time alignment remains unimplemented.
observed: The public ISO conformance amendment limits absolute sacTimeAlign magnitude to twice the spatial PCM frame size.
Inspected ISO source sac_dec.c accepts zero only; inspected FDK transport source also refuses nonzero alignment.
These sources did not establish sign encoding, offset direction and PCM/QMF association semantics sufficiently for implementing nonzero shifts.
decision: Keep raw16 bits and the explicit nonzero-alignment refusal. Do not claim support or guess sign/direction; continue other codec tools with available primary algorithms.
related_scope: A baseline MPEG-4 transport restriction in the2008 amendment requires in-band SSC equal to out-of-band SSC. Existing configuration-change controls are robustness/owned-API tests, not independent proof of strict baseline transport conformance.
